classifications.rationale: The President uses mandatory, present-tense proclamation language concerning specified federal lands, but this syntactically incomplete segment does not state what legal status or consequence is being proclaimed; that consequence appears only in segment 2.
classifications.evidence: hereby proclaim that all lands and interests in lands owned or controlled by the Government of the United States

classifications.rationale: The provision itself immediately reserves the federal lands as a national monument and withdraws them from entry, sale, leasing, and other disposition; the accompanying agency-management instructions implement that present legal designation.
classifications.evidence: are hereby set apart and reserved as the Fort Ord National Monument

classifications.rationale: The Secretary of the Interior must later prepare and maintain a transportation plan whose required designations impose specified limits on motorized and mechanized vehicle use.
classifications.evidence: motorized vehicle use shall be permitted only on designated roads
